overview: The commission reviewed status updates for historical preservation projects, demolition delay applications, and federal certification requirements. No major votes were taken other than the approval of past meeting minutes.

items.title: Cross Street Cemetery and Thomas Brooks Park
items.summary: The commission discussed restoration support for Cross Street Cemetery and received an update on a Community Preservation Committee grant for an archaeological cap at Thomas Brooks Park.

items.title: Demolition Delay and Property Updates
items.summary: Members discussed the status of 91 Winchester and 69 Court Street, noting that the latter owner still needs to submit a formal application for the commission to act upon.

items.title: Building Department and Dyer Building Marquee
items.summary: The chair reported the departure of the Building Commissioner and discussed strategies to ensure a developer installs a promised marquee at the Dyer building before receiving final certificates.

items.title: Certified Local Government (CLG) Reporting
items.summary: The commission is reconstructing past records to complete annual reporting required to maintain federal certification and access to state historical funding.

items.title: Walking Port and Survey Projects
items.summary: The commission submitted comments to the state regarding the Walking Port project and is pivoting between grant-funded survey projects in Fulton Heights and other areas.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from the previous session.
